tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: One prop trading firm. Every figure states whether we hold evidence for it, and a firm whose score range spans more than one band carries no letter grade at all.

tools.name: get_rule_changes
tools.description: The dated record of what changed, newest first. Every entry states its KIND, and most of this tape is FirmFax correcting its own data rather than a firm changing its rules. Read counts before describing industry activity: a total taken across kinds overstates it.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: The stored reading behind a figure: the verbatim quote, the page it came from, and the date we read it. Answers "we hold none" explicitly rather than returning an empty list. `outcome` is load-bearing: a `contradicted`, `contradiction` or `absent` row records what we read, not a figure we publish. U

tools.name: find_firms
tools.description: Firms matching every criterion given. A firm whose record does not carry a criterion is never counted as a match and never silently dropped: it is returned separately under unknown, with the field that could not be tested. Absence is common here, so read counts before treating the matched list as th

tools.name: compare_firms
tools.description: Two firms side by side. Reports each figure with its evidence state and whether the pair is comparable at all: a field neither firm records is not a tie, and a field only one records is not a win. No per-field winner is declared, because the direction of "better" for several of these is a judgement

tools.name: list_firms
tools.description: Every firm slug and name. Carries no figures, so nothing here needs evidence.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_firms" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
